entries.wording: 下单成功，待身份证实名认证
entries.english: Order placed, waiting for the recipient's ID check
entries.note: The first row of the older waybills, written when the customer books the parcel.

entries.wording: 运单创建成功，待身份证实名认证
entries.english: Waybill created, waiting for the recipient's ID check
entries.note: The first row of the newer waybills.

entries.wording: 身份证已认证，待打印面单
entries.english: ID checked, waiting to print the label

entries.note: Written a minute after the waybill, before the warehouse charges the parcel.

entries.wording: 包裹已扣费/正在组建出库批次
entries.english: Parcel charged, being put in an outbound batch
entries.note: The warehouse holds the parcel and has charged the shipment.

entries.wording: 包裹送往国际机场途中
entries.english: On the way to the international airport
Waiting for the flight to leave

entries.wording: 航班落地/等待办理提货手续
entries.english: The flight has landed, waiting for the release from the airline

entries.wording: 卡班运输至清关口岸途中
entries.english: By truck to the port of clearance
Documents under review, in customs clearance

entries.wording: 海关放行/包裹将由国内快递派送/顺丰速运/…
entries.english: Released by customs, a courier in China delivers the parcel: <courier>/<number>
entries.note: The last row of the older waybills, with the courier in China and its number.

entries.wording: 包裹清关完成，正匹配快递单号/中通国际/…；进入国内物流环节，等待派送
entries.english: Cleared, matched to a courier number <courier>/<number>; on to the network in China, waiting for delivery
entries.note: The last row of the newer waybills, with the courier in China and its number.
